mapper.update: UPDATE date_formats SET is_used = CASE WHEN id = #{dateFormatType.DateFormatId} THEN #{dateFormatType.DateFormatId} ELSE 0 END
UPDATE time_formats SET is_used = CASE WHEN id = #{dateFormatType.TimeFormatId } THEN #{dateFormatType.TimeFormatId} ELSE 0 END
mapper.select: SELECT df.id AS dateFormatId, tf.id AS timeFormatId FROM date_formats df CROSS JOIN time_formats tf WHERE df.is_used > 0 AND tf.is_used > 0;
